_comment: MCP config for smoke-run worker agents. Points workflow-server at THIS technique-branch build (not main's). WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE is replaced with the sandbox workspace at runtime so the worker shares the orchestrator's session.json, and WORKFLOW_DIR with the corpus the orchestrator opened its session on, which the worker's own server would otherwise resolve for itself. The seal key is machine-global (~/.workflow-server/secret), so both server instances verify the same sealed session.
